# Feedback

From [the component index](../components.md). A prop with `?` is optional, and `= x` is its default. An indented line is the shape of a value the prop takes. In the examples, `children`, `transactions`, the icons and the handlers stand for the screen's own content, data and state.

## Callout

```tsx
import { Callout } from "@tuja/ui/components/callout";
```

A message in the page, such as a warning before a destructive step or the result of a check.

Props (also `css`, and every attribute of `<div>`):

- `children: ReactNode` — Body content. Keep it short — a callout is a summary, not a paragraph.
- `intent?: "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "accent" | "neutral" = "info"` — Intent and default icon.
- `title?: ReactNode` — Optional bold heading rendered above the body.
- `action?: ReactNode` — One control that acts on the message, such as a small "Reconnect" `Button`.
- `icon?: ReactNode` — Leading icon. Defaults to a Phosphor icon for the intent; pass a different Phosphor icon (or any node) to override, or `null` to remove it.
- `role?: "status" | "alert"` — ARIA live role for the box.
- `onDismiss?: () => void` — Called when the user activates the close button.
- `dismissLabel?: string` — Accessible name for the close button — the package ships no i18n.

Example:

```tsx
function CalloutExample() {
  return (
    <Callout intent="warning" title="Remove the API key?">
      The bank sync stops until you add a new key.
    </Callout>
  );
}
```

## ToastProvider, Toast

```tsx
import { ToastProvider } from "@tuja/ui/components/toast-provider";
import { Toast } from "@tuja/ui/components/toast";
```

A short message about what an action did, with Undo; call `useToast()` and wrap the app in `ToastProvider` once.

`useToast` imports from `@tuja/ui/components/toast-provider` and returns `show({ message, action?, secondAction?, durationMs? })`. `Toast` is the surface alone.

### ToastProvider

Props (also `css`):

- `children: ReactNode` — The part of the app that can show a toast with `useToast`.
- `dismissLabel: string` — Accessible name for each toast's close button — the package ships no i18n.
- `portalTarget?: Element | DocumentFragment | null` — Where the toasts portal to.

### Toast

Props (also `css`, and every attribute of `<div>`):

- `message: ReactNode` — What happened, in a short sentence.
- `action?: ToastAction` — One action that follows from the message, such as Undo.
  - `ToastAction { label: string; onAction: () => void }`
- `secondAction?: ToastAction` — A second action after `action`, such as "Teach the AI" after Undo.
  - `ToastAction { label: string; onAction: () => void }`
- `onDismiss?: () => void` — Called when the visitor activates the close button, or presses Escape inside the toast.
- `dismissLabel?: string` — Accessible name for the close button — the package ships no i18n.

Example:

```tsx
function ToastProviderExample() {
  const show = useToast();
  return (
    <Button
      onClick={() => {
        show({
          message: "Transaction deleted",
          action: { label: "Undo", onAction: restore },
        });
      }}
    >
      Delete
    </Button>
  );
}
```

## Progress

```tsx
import { Progress } from "@tuja/ui/components/progress";
```

How much of a task of known length is done.

Props (also `css`, and every attribute of `<div>`):

- `value: number` — How much is done.
- `max?: number = 100` — The value that means finished.
- `label: string` — Accessible name (e.g. "Upload progress").
- `size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" = "md"` — Track thickness. The steps map to `rem` so the bar scales with the user's font size (WCAG 1.4.4).

## Spinner

```tsx
import { Spinner } from "@tuja/ui/components/spinner";
```

Work with no known end.

Props (also `css`, and every attribute of `<span>`):

- `size?: "inline" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" = "md"` — Rendered diameter. `sm`/`md`/`lg` map to `rem`, so the ring scales with the user's font size (WCAG 1.4.4).
- `tone?: "accent" | "current" = "current"` — Colour. `"current"` (default) inherits `currentColor` so the spinner picks up the surrounding text colour; `"accent"` pins the brand accent.
- `label?: string` — Accessible name announced via a polite live region (e.g. "Loading").
- `aria-hidden?: true` — Marks the spinner purely decorative — use inside a region that already announces the busy state (e.g. a button with `aria-busy`).

## Skeleton

```tsx
import { Skeleton } from "@tuja/ui/components/skeleton";
```

A placeholder in the shape of content that is loading.

Props (also `css`):

- `fill?: boolean` — Stretch to fill the parent's inline and block size.
- `width?: string | number` — Inline size. A number is treated as pixels; a string is passed through verbatim (e.g. `"100%"` or a token reference).
- `height?: string | number` — Block size. A number is treated as pixels; a string is passed through verbatim.
- `delay?: number` — Staggers the pulse start by N milliseconds — useful for lists of rows.
- `ref?: Ref<HTMLDivElement>` — Ref to the rendered element.
